sftp_user.description: SSH username; if empty, defaults to the current user name

sftp_password.description: SSH password; if empty, password authentication is disabled (use key-based auth)

sftp_privkey.description: Path to the private SSH key file; defaults to $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa

sftp_passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private SSH key; empty if unencrypted or no passphrase needed
